base_source_mode: all input and archive evidence bytes from fixed BASE Git objects

classification_rule.direct_product_basis: a reviewed concrete source span mapped to one product L1 with explicit boundary counterevidence and pending consumer evidence
classification_rule.insufficient_basis: source is generic, tombstone, shared infrastructure, or lacks an accepted product-boundary proof; observed Wave scope is not inherited
classification_rule.multi_product_conflict: reviewed source behavior contains concrete responsibilities mapped to two product boundaries; no single owner is proposed

old_asset_source_mode: archive bytes are read through git show BASE:<archive-path>; never executed
scope: phase product unresolved + src/runtime/ exact 73 assets
